name: offer-letter-docx
description: Fill Word offer letter templates with employee data, replacing {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens and handling {{IF_CONDITION}}...{{END_IF_CONDITION}} conditional blocks. Use this skill whenever the user asks to generate, fill, or produce an offer letter from a .docx template and a JSON data file, or whenever you need to merge HR data into a Word document template with placeholders and optional sections (e.g. relocation package, signing bonus).
